name: @angular-native/plugin-barcode
description: Reading a barcode with the camera, full screen, through AVFoundation — as an angular-native plugin.
author: Néstor García Bou

android.unsupported: Android ships no barcode API. The usual answer is ML Kit, which lives in Google Play Services and is a Gradle dependency; this toolchain has no Gradle, and bundling the Play-backed variant would make an app that cannot be installed on a device without Play Services. The alternative is embedding a decoder such as ZXing in the shell, which is a decision about what every angular-native app carries and not one a plugin can make on its own.

watchos.unsupported: a watch has no camera. AVFoundation's capture classes are not in the watchOS SDK at all.
